---
title: "H&E staining intensity across minor gland zones"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
```

## Data

Measurements (QuPath ellipse ROIs, 35 per zone) of mean hematoxylin and eosin
optical density from a single image.

```{r data}
he <- read_tsv("../data/HE_staining/HE_minorZones_35points.txt") |>
  transmute(
    zone = factor(Name, levels = c("ZoneA", "ZoneB", "ZoneC")),
    hematoxylin = `ROI: 1.00 px per pixel: Hematoxylin: Mean`,
    eosin       = `ROI: 1.00 px per pixel: Eosin: Mean`,
    area        = `Area px^2`
  )

count(he, zone)
anyNA(he)
```

```{r palette}
# Shared zone colours used in the other analyses (Zones: ZoneA, ZoneB, ZoneC, Duct)
source("colorSchemes_minor.R")
zone_cols <- Zones[c("ZoneA", "ZoneB", "ZoneC")]
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
he |>
  pivot_longer(c(hematoxylin, eosin), names_to = "stain", values_to = "mean_od") |>
  group_by(stain, zone) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(mean_od), sd = sd(mean_od),
            median = median(mean_od), .groups = "drop")
```

## Combined figure

```{r figure, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5}
library(patchwork)

he_long <- he |>
  pivot_longer(c(hematoxylin, eosin), names_to = "stain", values_to = "mean_od")

# Dunn post hoc (Holm) per stain, with bracket positions for the plot
dunn_pos <- he_long |>
  group_by(stain) |>
  dunn_test(mean_od ~ zone, p.adjust.method = "holm") |>
  add_xy_position(x = "zone", scales = "free_y", step.increase = 0.1)

p_scatter <- ggplot(he, aes(hematoxylin, eosin, fill = zone)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 1.2, stroke = 0.2, colour = "grey20", alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = zone_cols) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
  labs(x = "Hematoxylin (mean OD)", y = "Eosin (mean OD)", fill = "Zone") +
  theme_minimal()

p_box <- ggplot(he_long, aes(zone, mean_od, fill = zone)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(dunn_pos, label = "p.adj.signif", tip.length = 0.01,
                             hide.ns = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~stain, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = zone_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean OD", fill = "Zone",
       caption = "Dunn test, Holm-adjusted: * p<0.05, **** p<0.0001, ns not significant") +
  theme_minimal()

fig_he <- (p_scatter + p_box) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.5), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

fig_he

ggsave("../figures/HE_zones_combined.pdf", fig_he, width = 11, height = 5)
```

## Statistics

The ROIs come from one image, so they are subsamples of one tissue section,
not independent biological replicates; p-values describe differences within this
section only. Normality and equal variance were not assumed, so we use
Kruskal-Wallis with Dunn post hoc tests (Holm-adjusted).

```{r stats}
for (s in c("hematoxylin", "eosin")) {
  cat("\n=====", s, "=====\n")
  f <- reformulate("zone", s)
  print(kruskal_test(he, f))
  print(kruskal_effsize(he, f))
  print(dunn_test(he, f, p.adjust.method = "holm"))
}
```

```{r multivariate}
# Joint test of both stains
summary(manova(cbind(hematoxylin, eosin) ~ zone, data = he), test = "Pillai")
```
